note: Patch-note schemas the official docs omit. Merged after mine. confidence patch is dropdown-valid.

effects.description: Converts incoming damage of this type into healing. value is the damage type string; secondary_value is the heal ratio (0.5 = heal for 50% of damage dealt). Vanilla Feed On Electricity uses electricity + 0.2.
Increases damage dealt on knockback collisions. Vanilla Knock It Down uses 0.2.
Increases stamina regeneration. Valid on abilities and stackers (patch). Not seen in vanilla ability JSON; do not confuse with the entity stamina.stamina_regen field.
Per-stack stamina regeneration bonus.
Per-stack bonus damage. Patch: Bonus Damage now works in stackers.
Per-stack bonus damage percent. Patch: Bonus Damage Percent now works in stackers.
Per-stack bonus damage (ability key name damage_bonus). Patch: works in stackers.
Per-stack bonus damage percent (ability key name damage_bonus_percent).
Creates an item for the player when any being is killed. value is item id; secondary_value is chance (vanilla Taste for Souls uses 1.0 on the persona variant).
Creates an item when a persona (settlement NPC) is killed. Vanilla Taste for Souls: value core_2_Soul_Piece, secondary_value 1.0.
Chance for an extra attack when attacking (not abilities). Docs: 0.1 = 10%.
Flat incoming damage reduction. Warlock Dark One's Own Luck / Greater Ward. value is an int (2, 3, 4). Not in vanilla passives.json under this name, but the engine honors it on passives.
Ignore infravision daylight penalty to sight (same as Dread Mask). Docs example value 1. This is not infravision/sight as a passive.
Restore this fraction of max stamina on kill. Docs: 0.1 = 10%.
Extends duration of a buff/ability. value is ability id; secondary_value is duration modifier (1.0 = +100%). Vanilla Sprint Boost.
City-worker companion craft. Third parameter is the number of resources (patch). Still a settlement trick — do not ship as a combat skill filler.
Better sale prices for a specific item type. value is likely the bonus; secondary_value is item_type index from messages.json.
Replaces only_party. party_only = bonuses only on companions. solo_only = only with no companions. Omit for everyone.
Optional skills.json starting level for this skill.
Innate milestones are skipped when checking skill level-up requirements. Grant on entities via skills.milestones (Entity Editor → Skills → Milestones).
